label: Before he bursts in: Dr. Roylott traces his stepdaughter
quote: I have traced her
note: The text does not say how or when; she must have left home first. Repeated at ¶110.

label: Some time before: Dr. Roylott hears of Holmes
quote: I have heard of you before

label: That morning: the door is dashed open and a huge man stands in the doorway
quote: our door had been suddenly dashed open

note: ¶95: the door bursting open is what draws the exclamation.

label: That morning: the huge man asks which of them is Holmes
quote: Which of you is Holmes?

label: That morning: Holmes owns to his name
quote: you have the advantage of me

label: That morning: the man declares himself Dr. Grimesby Roylott
quote: I am Dr. Grimesby Roylott, of Stoke Moran

label: That morning: Holmes offers Dr. Roylott a seat
quote: Pray take a seat

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott refuses, and demands what his stepdaughter has been saying
quote: What has she been saying to you?

label: That morning: Holmes remarks on the cold
quote: It is a little cold for the time of the year

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott screams his demand again
quote: screamed the old man furiously

label: That morning: Holmes goes on about the crocuses
quote: the crocuses promise well

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott steps forward, shaking his hunting-crop, and calls Holmes a meddler
quote: taking a step forward and shaking his hunting-crop

label: That morning: Holmes smiles
quote: My friend smiled

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott calls Holmes a busybody
quote: Holmes, the busybody!

label: That morning: Holmes's smile broadens
quote: His smile broadened

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott calls Holmes a Scotland Yard Jack-in-office
quote: Holmes, the Scotland Yard Jack-in-office!

label: That morning: Holmes chuckles and asks him to close the door when he goes
quote: Holmes chuckled heartily

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott warns Holmes not to meddle in his affairs
quote: Don’t you dare to meddle with my affairs

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott steps forward, seizes the poker and bends it
quote: seized the poker, and bent it into a curve

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott snarls a threat and hurls the poker into the fireplace
quote: hurling the twisted poker into the fireplace

label: That morning: Dr. Roylott strides out of the room
quote: he strode out of the room

label: That morning: Holmes laughs, picks up the poker and straightens it
quote: straightened it out again

label: That morning: Holmes speaks of the incident and of what he will do next
quote: This incident gives zest to our investigation

label: That morning: Holmes and Watson are to order breakfast
quote: we shall order breakfast
note: Planned; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: After breakfast: Holmes means to walk down to Doctors’ Commons
quote: afterwards I shall walk down to Doctors’ Commons
note: What he intends; the text does not order it against the visit to Stoke Moran.
